title: Figures 15-16: Thermopile glucose sensor micrograph, illustration and blood glucose plot
description: Figure 15 pairs a photomicrograph of a gold-and-gray striped thermopile sensor with a color illustration labeling "Antimony," "Bismuth," "Thin Mylar Substrate," "Enzyme," "Measuring Junctions" and "Reference Junctions"; the caption notes the device is about 8 mm long with ~50 micron geometries. Figure 16, "Photograph and Illustration of the Thermopile Glucose Sensor in a Catheter," shows a "Glucose Catheter Sensor" slide schematic and a line graph of "Concentration, mg%" versus "Time" (10 min scale) with an arrow marking "Insulin" administration and a subsequent decline. The caption states the response was recorded in a pig (ASU research).
